method.scope: Complete syntactic inventory and bounded static review of exact source call paths. Not a claim of exhaustive dynamic verification or line-by-line review of all repository source.

findings.observation: The inspected .hepta program is real hia-asm.v1/hepta.hia.program.v8 text. The selfhost and component source production still runs Python AST/document/verify/render orchestration and writes .hepta outputs. All74 tracked tools/(gen_|generate_)hia_*.py paths remain. Absence of .hiaasm extension does not mean the generators have been rewritten in HIA.

build_program_selfhost uses an explicit bounded native compiler for its admitted object profile. Python still validates target/kind, owns subprocess.Popen on /proc/self/fd, bounds streams/deadlines, checks selection and publishes the exact output. This is an existing native compiler component plus a Python orchestration boundary, not elimination of Python.

The cold replay exports/checks source and invokes sys.executable -I -S -B tools/qualify_hia_selfhost.py under the original180-second qualification plus3-second cleanup owner. Contract source references include Python generators. These source/driver duties remain Python.

Native-process lifetime/streams/resource observation and exact file/inode publication remain Python mechanisms. The reference publication path performs lstat/open/read/identity checks and no-replace os.link plus exact-byte rechecks. Merely deleting these modules would remove required ownership/publication behavior.
